# Repository Skills

This folder contains repository-local skills for recurring documentation and governance workflows.

## Available Skills

- [policy-definition](policy-definition/SKILL.md): Define enterprise authorization policies with orthogonal boundary controls and governance metadata.
- [policy-cohesion-review](policy-cohesion-review/SKILL.md): Review requirement and policy cohesion for conflicts, ambiguity, and enterprise readiness.
- [policy-architecture-sync](policy-architecture-sync/SKILL.md): Keep [PRD.md](../../PRD.md) and [ARCHITECTURE.md](../../ARCHITECTURE.md) synchronized to prevent drift.

## Usage Pattern

1. Select the skill matching the task intent.
2. Read its `When To Use`, `Workflow`, and `Definition Of Done` sections.
3. Apply outputs with references to [PRD.md](../../PRD.md) and [ARCHITECTURE.md](../../ARCHITECTURE.md).
